summary: Frontend regression test for bug fix on 'Tugaskan Klien' dialog in /app/users. All scenarios PASSED: client/coach dropdowns remain populated regardless of table filter (filter-coach, filter-client) or search-emptied table. E2E assignment succeeds and coach name appears in table. No console errors on repeated dialog open/close.
critical_code_review_comments: Users.jsx: uses SelectItem value='__empty' which is fine because disabled, but consider showing loading spinner while assignLists is fetching to distinguish from truly empty state.
assignLists is not refreshed after successful assignment; harmless because dialog closes, but if reopened quickly, cached list is used (acceptable).
seed_data_creation: Used existing coach 'Test Coach (test_coach_a45315@test.com)'. Assigned Finish Tester (finish.1789452796@mail.com) -> Test Coach for verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix for assignLists (separate fetch of clients/coaches independent from table filters) is verified working on preview URL. Verified via: (1) filter=coach → open dialog → client dropdown has 11 clients; (2) filter=client → coach dropdown has 1 coach; (3) search returning empty table still shows full dropdowns; (4) E2E assign succeeded, coach name displayed in row. Only 401 on /api/auth/me before login (expected).
rca of the issue: Previous code reused the filtered `users` state for both dropdowns in the assign dialog, so applying role filter or search would empty the dropdowns. Fix decouples fetch: on assignOpen=true, GET /api/admin/users?role=client and ?role=coach populates independent assignLists state; SelectContent maps assignLists.clients/coaches with empty-state fallbacks. Verified end-to-end.
